description: Sentori — ops overview. Every expression here names a metric that self-hosted/server/src/handlers/metrics_prom.rs actually emits; scripts/check-metric-names.mjs fails the build if that stops being true.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Active connections against the configured max. The PgPoolNearSaturation alert fires at 0.80 of this ratio. Replaced an ingest-latency panel that queried sentori_ingest_duration_seconds_bucket — the server exposes no histogram, so it drew nothing.

panels.title: Rate limited (events / sec)
panels.description: Requests turned away by the per-token limiter. Replaced a quota-drops panel: quotas were a SaaS concept and left with it.

panels.title: Ingest error rate (5m)
panels.description: rejected (bad payload, client's bug) + failed (pipeline error, ours) as a fraction of all ingest attempts. rate_limited is excluded — a throttled burst is the limiter working.
